reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT s.store_code FROM orders o RIGHT JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id AND o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

SELECT s.store_code FROM stores s LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' GROUP BY s.store_code HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) = 0

other_way.sql: SELECT s.store_code FROM stores s LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.ship_to_country = 'BE' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' GROUP BY s.store_code HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) = 0
other_way.tradeoff: Grouping and keeping a count of 0 finds the same stores, but it builds a count only to throw it away.
